profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Apple Platforms Engineer with 15+ years of experience leading teams and developing scalable, high-performance applications across iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, watchOS, tvOS, and macOS. Skilled in architecting Swift-based solutions, driving cross-platform adoption, and reducing tech debt in large-scale applications. Passionate about mentoring engineers, making architectural decisions, and fostering innovation in Apple’s evolving ecosystem.

positions.title: Software Engineer, iOS
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Lead iOS Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of a next-generation Swift-based iOS application for 1.2M+ monthly active investors, modernizing legacy systems and enhancing performance. 
• Delivered a high-quality user experience, contributing to the iOS app’s 4.7 out of 5 rating from 175K reviews on the App Store. 
• Developed visionOS, watchOS, and tvOS apps, positioning the company for multi-platform expansion and enabling investors to access Vanguard services seamlessly across devices. 
• Architected and modernized Vanguard’s iOS platform by introducing SwiftUI and Swift Testing, reducing UI implementation time by 30% and increasing unit test coverage to 60% with 10,000+ tests. 
• Mentored and guided a core iOS team, providing architectural direction, code reviews, and career development support while collaborating with Product, Design, Android, and Backend teams to align the iOS roadmap. 
• Championed company-wide innovation by presenting a visionOS prototype as a top 4 hackathon finalist and evaluating AI-driven ideas in a Shark Tank-style review committee.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · SwiftUI · UIKit · Xcode · Apple Developer · RealityKit · WatchKit · Swift Testing · XCTest · iOS development · Postman API · JIRA · Confluence · Figma (Software) · Kotlin · Android Studio · Visual Studio Code · GitHub · Bitbucket · Adobe Analytics · Honeycomb · Splunk · AppDynamics

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained Concierge, an iOS app deployed on thousands of iPads across 300+ airport restaurants and retail locations.
 • Integrated new app features, including recommendation engines, ad-supported gaming, and airline miles purchases. 
• Led iOS interface design improvements utilizing A/B testing, optimizing user flows and ensuring accessibility compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · UIKit · Objective-C · Xcode · Apple Developer · iOS development · XCTest · GitHub · Visual Studio Code

positions.title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and maintained multiple iOS applications for medical professionals, including ClinicalKey and Clinical Pharmacology. 
• Replaced legacy Objective-C with Swift, improving maintainability, reducing development time, and accelerating the release of current medical research used by healthcare professionals worldwide.
 • Developed watchOS and tvOS apps to expand the company’s mobile strategy, integrating medical resources into emerging platforms.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · Objective-C · UIKit · Xcode · WatchKit · Apple Developer · iOS development · XCTest · JIRA · Confluence · Android Studio · Visual Studio Code · GitHub

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: • Developed personal finance apps, upgraded the app from MRC to ARC, implemented Auto Layout to enhance UI responsiveness, and transitioned the app to iOS 7.
positions.insights: Skills: Objective-C · UIKit · Xcode · Apple Developer · iOS development · XCTest

positions.title: Applications Programmer
positions.description: • Maintained an ERP solution, developed a Proof of Delivery iOS app, and trained junior developers.
